rows.content:
{[if MarriedTF]}If there is no surviving spouse, e{[else]}E{[endif]}ach beneficiary entered in this list will receive a percentage of the estate. The percent across all beneficiaries should total 100%.

For example, if there are four beneficiaries with unequal amounts, an example might be entering "20" here for the first beneficiary, then on the next popup entering "20" for the second beneficiary, "10" for the third beneficiary, and "50" for the fourth beneficiary, so that the total equals 100.

This Trust will distribute a part of the property to this beneficiary at certain ages. The amount of the distribution will be determined by how many ages are entered.

If only one age is entered, the entire Trust property will be distributed to the beneficiary outright when the beneficiary reaches that age. If two ages are entered, half will be distributed when the beneficiary reaches the first age and half when the beneficiary reaches the second age.

For example, if the beneficiary should recieve 1/3 of the Trust property at age 25, 1/3 at age 30, and the last 1/3 at age 35, you would enter 25, 30, and 35 as the ages in the list below.

Assets distributed to  {[Recipient.NameCO|else: "this beneficiary"]} will be held in trust until the age(s) you deemed old enough to own assets outright free of trust. The trust stipulates how the assets should be managed, and how, when and to whom the assets will be distributed.

Assets inside the trust are managed by a **Trustee** who has legal responsibility for managing and overseeing trust proceeds. 

You may select Co-Trustees (more than one person) to serve at the same time.  Decisions of Co-Trustees would be made jointly by mutual consent.

####
Successor Trustees
The successor trustees serve if all of the initial trustees are unable to serve. These successor trustees will serve in the order they are entered. Successor trustees are not required, but are usually recommended.

properties.label: Select if you wish to use Limited Purpose Trustees
properties.helpText:
Limited Purpose Trustees will include a Managing Trustee and a Distribution Trustee. The Managing Trustee will be charged with managing trust assets, while the Distribution Trustee will be charged with making distribution decisions. 

<accent red>**DO NOT USE Full Purpose Trustees for Asset Protection Trusts. Also, do not name a Beneficiary as Distribution Trustee of an Asset Protection Trust.**</accent>

properties.label: Check if you wish to delay this outright distribution for up to 24 MONTHS following the death of the Settlor(s).
properties.helpText: Statistically, 70% of the time a beneficiary will squander an inheritance within 18 months of receiving it. A delayed distribution may help avoid this scenario. Ifthis option is selected, the distribution will be withheld for up to 24 months.

properties.helpText: If the special bequest is to someone who is NOT also a residual beneficiary, then a separate share trust can be created for the recipient if the bequest is not outright free of trust. If the special bequest is in trust to someone who IS a residual beneficiary, then the bequest will directed to the residuary trust as there is no need to create two separate share trusts. That said, if you wish to create a separate share trust with different terms and conditions, then select "yes" to create a separate share trust for this specific bequest.

The more discretion afforded to the Trustee to say "no", the greater the asset protection afforded to the trust.

properties.name: MandatePrincipalCapTF
properties.label: Do you wish to impose a cap / max on the percentage of principal that can be distributed to a beneficiary in the discretion of the Trustee?
properties.helpText: For example, principal distributions can be limited to 2% per year.

properties.name: MandatePrincipalCapAge
properties.label: *Enter the age at which the cap / limit on principal distributions will be removed to allow unlimited distributions of principal in the discretion of the Trustee*
properties.helpText: For example, enter age 65 to allow unlimited distributions of principal at such age. Principal distributions will be limited to a stated percentage until such time.

properties.name: MandatePrincipalCap
properties.label: *Enter the maximum percentage of principal that can be distributed to the beneficiary on an annual basis.*
properties.helpText: For example, if 2% is entered, then the Trustee will be prohibited from distributing more than 2% of principal on an annual basis.

properties.name: WillMandateDollarAmountTF
properties.label: Mandate a set dollar amount for required distributions?
properties.helpText: For example, the Trustee shall distribute $1,000.00 per month to the beneficiary.

properties.name: WillResiduaryTestPowerAge

properties.helpText: You must set a minimum age for a Beneficiary to be allowed to exercise a Power of Appointment considering the maturity level and circumstances of the Beneficiary.

properties.helpText: The Trustee will be prohibited from distributing more than this amount on an annual basis.

properties.name: MandateDollarAmountTF

properties.label: Mandate distributions for educational expenses?
properties.helpText: This will require the Trustee to make distributions for college, post-secondary studies, or trade school.

properties.label: Mandate distributions of a percentage of the principal of the Trust?
properties.helpText: If selected, the Trustee will distribute a percentage of the Trust princpal at least annually.

properties.name: InflationIndexingTF
properties.label: Select if the mandatory distribution amount should be adjusted annually for inflation.
properties.helpText: For example, if distributions of $1,000 per month are mandated for life, select this option to index the amount for inflation.

properties.name: MandatoryPeriod
properties.label: How often should these distributions occur?

properties.name: RestrictAccessToPrincipalTF
properties.label: Restrict distributions of principal to the beneficiary until a certain age?
properties.helpText: If selected, the Trustee will be precluded from distributing principal of the Trust to or on behalf of the Beneficiary until the designated age.

properties.name: PercentPrincipalDist
properties.label: *Enter the percent of the principal of the Trust to be distributed annually.*

properties.name: MaximumAmount
properties.label: *Maximum annual distribution amount:*
properties.helpText: The Trustee will be prohibited from distributing more than this amount on an annual basis.

properties.name: MinAgeWageDistributions
properties.label: *Select the minimum age to commence minimum distributions for purposes of Wage Matching*
properties.helpText: Minimum distributions will commence at this age. Make sure there is no conflict with other mandatory distributions (if any); Note any minimum distribution may be nominal (e.g., One Dollar).

properties.name: MinimumAmount
properties.label: *Minimum annual distribution amount:*
properties.helpText: The Trustee will be required to distribute at least this amount annually.

properties.label: Are the recipients getting equal shares of this bequest? i.e., if you are giving the property to John and Jane, should they each own 50% of the property?
